description: List the organization's managed codes and short links, newest first. This is the way to find a code's `id` before retargeting it, and the way to check what already exists before creating more. Filter by `group` (a whole batch) or `external_ref` (one specific code). Set include_stats=true to get every code's all-time scan count in the same response — far cheaper than calling qrtap_code_stats per code when you only need totals.

external_ref.description: Optional filter: only the code carrying this external reference (exact match). The fastest way to check whether a code for a given branch/SKU already exists.

group.description: Optional filter: only codes filed under this group (partner | equipment | event_menu | bag_insert | training).

include_stats.description: When true, adds an all-time non-bot `scans` counter to every returned code. Use it to compare a whole batch in one call.

offset.description: Pagination offset; add `limit` to walk further batches.

name: qrtap_list_codes
